julia_notes: min_abs_coeff boundary: PauliPropagation.jl drops |c| < eps (strict), paulistrings drops |c| <= eps (inclusive); the two disagree only when a coefficient lands exactly on the threshold.
max_weight boundary: both engines keep weight == max_weight.
exact-zero coefficients survive in PauliPropagation.jl but are dropped by the paulistrings merge, so an exactly-cancelling circuit can differ by term count.
truncation is applied after every gate (no layer concept), so one gate object must equal one paulistrings channel.
per_layer_terms is in APPLICATION order, which for direction="heisenberg" is the reverse of the order gates appear in the task file.
